scope: Actual native CP plus full actual-Form GIC plus raw IR imply ModelsDecoded; existing EncBundle all-Form adapters then close exact ModelsDecoded iff ModelsEncodable on an irreflexive structure with supplied valuation. No quotient IR or consistency endpoint.
audit_source:
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeDecoded254
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientCPGIC

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeDecoded254
open ProfileCollection ProfileModel QuotientModel Tarski

#print axioms matrix_instance
#print axioms sat_dec_bundle_named
#print axioms namedC_of_containers
#print axioms forward_matrix
#print axioms support_matrix
#print axioms namedG_same
#print axioms namedG_distinct
#print axioms namedG_of_fullGIC
#print axioms named_vacuity
#print axioms modelsDecoded
#print axioms no_refutation
#print axioms fullGIC_of_encodable
#print axioms decoded_of_encodable
#print axioms modelsDecoded_iff_modelsEncodable

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

-- Truth-code zero with colliding input/output binders.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (hc : Containers mem) (hg : FullGIC mem) (a : Nat) (ha : 0 ≠ a) (e : Nat → V) :
    Tarski.Sat mem e (Code254.dec (Code254.bundle a a 0)) :=
  modelsDecoded mem hirr hc hg a a 0 ha ha e

-- Truth-code zero with distinct binders.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (hg : FullGIC mem) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : 0 ≠ a) (hb : 0 ≠ b) (hab : a ≠ b) (e : Nat → V) :
    Tarski.Sat mem e (Code254Containers.namedG a b 0 (Code254.dec 0)) :=
  namedG_distinct mem hirr hg a b 0 hab ha hb e

-- Native Eq(1,2) is exactly code35, not an equality-free matrix.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (hc : Containers mem) (hg : FullGIC mem) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : 35 ≠ a) (hb : 35 ≠ b) (e : Nat → V) :
    Code254.dec 35 = .eq 1 2 ∧
      Tarski.Sat mem e (Code254.dec (Code254.bundle a b 35)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, modelsDecoded mem hirr hc hg a b 35 ha hb e⟩
  exact Code254.dec_weq 1 2

-- Code4 contains a nested zero and need not be in the named encoder's image.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (hc : Containers mem) (hg : FullGIC mem) (a b : Nat)
    (ha : 4 ≠ a) (hb : 4 ≠ b) (e : Nat → V) :
    Tarski.Sat mem e (Code254.dec (Code254.bundle a b 4)) :=
  modelsDecoded mem hirr hc hg a b 4 ha hb e

-- The quotient can be used only with a separately supplied quotient IR proof.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (w : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (hQIR : ∀ x, ¬ quotientMember mem w h x x) : ¬ Code254.C254 Code254.F :=
  no_refutation (quotientMember mem w h) hQIR
    (QuotientCPGIC.quotient_containers mem w h)
    (QuotientCPGIC.quotient_fullGIC mem w h)
    (fun _ => mk mem w h w)

-- Completeness's exact EncBundle class feeds soundness's decoded model class.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (h : Code254Models.ModelsEncodable mem) (valuation : Nat → V) :
    ¬ Code254.C254 Code254.F :=
  Code254Models.no_refutation_of_decoded mem hirr
    (decoded_of_encodable mem hirr h valuation) valuation

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.NativeDecoded254

matrix_schema: Every native actual Form including equality via NamedForm254.matrix; not an EF-only or arbitrary semantic relation schema.
gates: Original c != a and c != b retained throughout; no a != b assumption on final result.
binder_collision: Separate a=b branch uses an empty false-matrix image and raw IR to vacate the input guard.
all_natural_codes: DecodeFresh254.sat_context_update_own_code includes c=0 truth alias and nested zero codes; no encoder-image or syntactic zero-freshness assumption.
relative_falsity: Global raw IR under every valuation/binder; no assumption that Rel00 is syntactically closed.
nonempty_refutation_statement: Explicit valuation supplied only in no_refutation; universal ModelsDecoded adapter itself needs none.
initial_check_notes: One source simp needed unfolding PositiveClosure.Sub. Initial concrete fully numeral-valued bundle callers exceeded elaborator recursion because the code is huge; final callers keep binder labels arbitrary while fixing zero/35/4 matrix codes. No theorem assumptions weakened.
independent_review: Fibers read full initial native-model adapter source and found binder collision, own-code semantic freshness includingzero, gates, update ordering and valuation scope clean. Root identified the existing all-native-Form EncBundle adapter; the three model-comparison conclusions use it directly.
